title: SASjs Server
tagline: Stored programs in JavaScript and Python
author: 4GL Ltd

first-user-becomes-admin.message: There is no pre-created admin account. The FIRST user to sign in becomes the administrator; every user after that is a normal user, so grant the others what they need under Settings > Permissions. To seed a local break-glass `admin` account instead, put `ADMIN_PASSWORD_INITIAL=<a strong password>` in `/app/data/.env` and restart the app.

restrict-drive-writes.message: The `js` and `py` runtimes execute whatever is uploaded to SASjs Drive, server-side. Grant Drive write access only to trusted authors, and keep the app behind Cloudron access control.
